row.title: FAILURE-RESOLVE-1: an audit that files where no loop reads is detection without resolution
row.body: The failure audit wrote AUDIT-<id>.json to branch audit-evidence with done check detector:<id>: outside foundation/queue.items, no probe kind, never on main. Two detectors failed five daily runs untaken. Findings now land on main as Q-AUDIT-<id> with a cmd: closing probe and root-cause suspects; failure_audit --check fails on an unwatched mode or an unfiled finding. Detectors must run on main's own files: overlaying docs/issues from an evidence branch produced false failures.
